head: 0175eca
summary: P1-P6 complete. Repeated conductor failure repaired with persistent parity test-host oracle settings, selected only when caller environment/settings are absent. With TCC_PYTHON removed from the parent process, the same build, format and whole-solution fast gates pass: 18 Domain, 152 parity, 125 persistence and 13 architecture tests. Version validation remains enforced; no machine/user environment or parity source was changed. The real-writer capstone preserves all 12 certified payloads. Live Warehouse behavior remains unverified.

deviations.what: Required persistence report, log, improvements and status paths were written; the obsolete ownership halt was removed.
deviations.why: The conductor's repair instruction explicitly required these documentation/status changes, resolving the initial writable-path contradiction.

deviations.what: Gold publication and complete calculation side effects use database transactions, retaining the prior successful state on failure.
deviations.why: The Python retirement-before-insert sequence can expose a failed replacement; CAP-06 assessment can fail after Gold writes. No valid calculated value was changed.

deviations.what: SQLite uses schema-derived STRICT tables and exact decimal text; native parameters use typed SqlDecimal without System.Decimal truncation.
deviations.why: Numeric fixture rendering, claim exponents and deployed DECIMAL column scales are distinct contracts, not a license to use floating money.

deviations.what: SQLite operational initialization includes supplemental tcc_ops.finding_audit.
deviations.why: Finding-resolution audit durability needs a destination absent from the checked-in SQL bootstrap; deployed operator provisioning is documented.

deviations.what: The owned central props file conditionally selects an owned oracle runsettings file for the parity project.
deviations.why: The conductor's repeated repair request requires plain unattended test invocations to work without shell-local TCC_PYTHON. This narrowly extends original packages-only guidance without editing parity sources or global environment. Explicit caller configuration is preserved.

findings: F-3: positive Int64 client binding refuses huge identifiers before SQL; W2 maps the refusal to JSON-detail 422.
F-8: duplicate storage identities are explicit conflicts; legitimate same-cell history append remains supported. HTTP duplicate-create idempotency/409 belongs to W2.
F-18: Gold reads and manifest writes share one durable destination; an accepted run is visible after restart rather than hidden by a disconnected in-memory profile.
E-2: DISTINCT TOP is a SQLite recording-harness translation defect; DISTINCT and ordinary paging execute with the native dialect.
E-7: AddPersistence registers the governed query port; employee-level authorization defaults denied.
E-9: decompressed content_sha256 is verified separately from shipped gzip sha256.
The actual money DDL is DECIMAL(19,4), not the contract report's shorthand DECIMAL(18,2). Typed payload equality is checked before storage conversion.
Six local migration identities represent bootstrap plus five forward migrations; applied content-hash drift and incompatible schema are refused.

Missing parent-process TCC_PYTHON is now supplied explicitly to the parity test host by conditional Oracle.runsettings. The existing resolver still requires CPython 3.12; explicit caller environment/settings remain authoritative. No shared user/global environment was modified.
SQLite governed monetary SUM is exact; monetary AVG retains Python SQLite native floating arithmetic rather than silently changing a derived figure.

needs_human.why: No live systems were authorized or contacted. Native decimal/date/AVG metadata, pooling/token refresh, cross-replica publication and concurrency remain unmeasured.

needs_human.item: Provision supplemental finding audit in the deployed schema
needs_human.why: tcc_ops.finding_audit is required for durable resolution/reopen history. Existing operator migrations remain outside this session's ownership.

needs_human.item: M-01 ingested override of year-resolved values
needs_human.why: Retained as certified; changing wage_basis, measuring_date or pay-code behavior changes calculated figures and requires an owner decision.
Retained as Python/certified behavior; introducing a new refusal or choosing another program changes valid-request figures.
Replacing Python-compatible native floating AVG with exact decimal arithmetic may change derived query figures; this is not a parity waiver.
